sprints.name: Week 1 — Infrastructure + App Shell + Rules Skeleton

cards.title: AWS infra provisioning — EC2 (n8n), ECS Fargate, S3, Secrets Manager, CloudWatch, ALB, ECR
Standalone EA app shell — Next.js 14 scaffold, Dockerfile, ALB target group, Clerk auth, /pipeline/* route protection
Supabase schema + RLS — 6 tables: pipeline_runs, rules_evaluations, engagement_events, partner_pushes, human_review_queue, pdf_hand_edit_audit
rules.json skeleton + CI validation — schema check, canned-applicant test set, cohort_a_fallback presence
SmartMove adapter (Module 7) + flag-transition trigger — conditional on D2 + D4a

sprints.name: Week 2 — Core Engine + CV Ingestion + n8n Orchestration

cards.title: 5 deep pure-function modules — cohort classifier, rules engine, Zoom-CTA resolver, for-human-review router, cohort transition de-dupe
Talent Seeker CV ingestion adapter (Module 6) — async callback, correlation_id matching, retry-exhaustion handling
n8n pipeline orchestration — flag-change trigger → cohort classify → de-dupe → ingest → C1 queue → rules → router → render → C2 queue → dispatch
Milestone M2: cohort classifier + rules engine unit tests green; pipeline trigger fires on test record #14458

sprints.name: Week 3 — Report Renderer + C2 Hand-Edit + Email Dispatcher

cards.title: Report renderer (Module 10) — Jinja/docxtpl master template → Puppeteer PDF, conditional sections, yellow-section Claude API, golden-file regression suite, S3 storage
C2 workflow in standalone app (View A2) — approve / reject+hand-edit / escalate / route-not-eligible, pdftotext diff, audit writes
Email dispatcher (Module 8) — Brevo Transactional v3, EA + auto-ack + CV-prompt templates, idempotency on pipeline_run_id
Milestone M3: EA PDF rendered from canned inputs; C2 approve sends EA email through Brevo

sprints.name: Week 4 — C1 + Failure Surface + NZ Job Portal + Burn-in Dashboard + E2E

cards.title: C1 workflow in standalone app (View A1) — pre-filled record, two-step CV-sharing consent (IPP 11), slow-path Cohort A→B banner, c1_cleared_at writes
Failure surface (View A3) — filtered failed_at_* queue + composed deep-link context view /pipeline/failures/[run_id]/context
NZ Job Portal two-step opt-in side-channel (Module 15) — fires on lead checkbox AND adviser C1 toggle, non-blocking, bounded retries
Engagement-event reader + Slack nudge worker — 4-hour cron, 14-day booking-join window, rate-limited per queue_type per hour (Allan only)
Burn-in dashboard (View A4) — wall-clock median, hand-edit rate, cannibalisation watch, C2 auto-flip eligible indicator, CloudWatch Alarms → SNS
10 Playwright E2E scenarios + nightly smoke + 6-layer CI gate — unit / integration / renderer regression / E2E / rules JSON / nightly
Milestone M4: full pipeline running on staging; adviser-training session with Allan; burn-in begins
